name: Roasted BBQ Chicken Drumsticks & Potatoes with Sautéed Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash, dry, and halve potatoes; transfer to one baking sheet. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg new potatoes
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat the other baking sheet with a thin layer of oil. Arrange chicken on the baking sheet and drizzle with barbecue sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
1.7 kg chicken drumsticks
¾ cup barbecue sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing potatoes and flipping chicken halfway through, until potatoes are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the chicken is almost done, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken, potatoes, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!
